1.explanation:
• UIShell/README.md provides the high-level metadata and links to the storybook docs, establishing how the component is registered and surfaced in the Docs tab.
• UIShell/UIShell.mdx defines the UIShell stories (including “Fixed SideNav”) and includes the ArgsTable (Component API) configuration that’s rendering incorrectly. Reviewing this MDX is necessary to see how each sub-component is passed to the Docs engine and why it isn’t picking up prop definitions.
1.bug_scenario: On the UIShell docs page in Storybook (e.g. the “Fixed SideNav” story under UIShell), the “Component API” section is rendering incorrectly. The very first tab shows “undefined” and all sub-components (Content, Header, HeaderMenuButton, etc.) display “No inputs found for this component.” Instead of pulling in each UIShell sub-component’s prop definitions, Storybook is failing to generate or link the tables. Elements involved include the MDX story file (which declares the stories and ArgsTable), the Meta configuration for each story, and the automatically generated Prop Tables in the DocsPane.
